package.name: odom_drift_checker
package.description:
Phase 0 diagnostic node for the cat-patrol robot.
Subscribes to /odom, integrates total path length, and logs accumulated drift each time the robot returns near its starting pose. Used to quantify wheel-odometry quality before SLAM / AMCL / Nav2 are added, so later debugging never has to ask "is it the planner, the localization, or the wheels?".
Single-file rclcpp node intended as a hands-on C++ / ROS 2 learning exercise (subscriptions, timers, tf2_ros::Buffer + TransformListener, std::optional, parameters).
